meta.name: linkedin-thread-monitor
meta.description: Track which of your LinkedIn comments earned author replies. Flags the 6-24h warm-reply window where thread momentum peaks, classifies threads as hot/warm/cool/dormant, and routes warm ones to linkedin-reply-handler for follow-up drafts. Powered by Apify, no LinkedIn login. Triggers on "what threads need follow-up", "author replied", "monitor my comments". Not for analyzing likers on a post (use linkedin-engager-analytics).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪你的 LinkedIn 评论是否被作者回复,并在互动最佳时机提醒你跟进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常在 LinkedIn 评论并想及时跟进作者的回复。
copy.tagline_en: Track which comments got author replies and catch the best moment to follow up
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you comment actively on LinkedIn and want to follow up when authors reply.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会跟踪你 LinkedIn 评论是否收到作者回复，把帖子按 hot/warm/cool/dormant 分级，并把 warm 帖子交给 linkedin-reply-handler 起草跟进回复。
howto.when: 当你提到 “what threads need follow-up”、“author replied” 等说法，或想查看最近 72 小时评论是否获作者回复时。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude tracks whether your LinkedIn comments got author replies, sorts threads as hot/warm/cool/dormant, and routes warm ones to linkedin-reply-handler for drafts. Needs APIFY_TOKEN, else you paste comment URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like “what threads need follow-up” and “author replied”, or when you check recent comments for author replies.

say_en.text: Which of my threads need follow-up today?
say_en.note: Builds the table with author-reply status
